data.gender_notes: Angat is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Angat is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Angah' which means body, strength and power. It is also a name of Lord Vishnu and is believed to bring strength and courage to the bearer. The name Angat carries the meaning “Powerful, Strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Angat usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Angat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
